sources.note: Main company website (redirected from vohraphysicians.com). Describes Vohra as largest wound care physician group, 3000+ SNFs in 28+ states, 1.4M annual visits. Overview of services and technology.
ONC certification details page. Lists certified criteria for VHS Medical Documentation and Coding v3.4, confirms no additional software relied upon for certification.
EHR product page. Describes proprietary wound care EHR with CDS, AI-based dressing recommendations, 6M wound database, and interoperability with leading platforms.
EMR integration page. Lists compatible systems: PCC, AHT, MatrixCare, Swift. Emphasizes regulatory compliance and AI/ML capabilities.
Physician testimonials about EMR. Physicians praise documentation efficiency (minutes per patient), specialty-focused design, and billing/coding assistance.
SNF services page. Details clinical services (debridement, Doppler, advanced therapies), PointClickCare/MatrixCare integration, MDS-compliant documentation, outcomes reporting.
Technology article. Describes ONC-certified EHR with online-offline functionality, CDS, integrated dressing selection triggering automatic supply delivery, predictive ML, mobile app.
Patient-facing page. Describes bedside and telemedicine care, insurance coverage (Medicare/Medicaid), billing department contact, and online bill payment.
Patient portal. Allows patients to securely access and manage wound care documents, with telemedicine integration.
Facility portal. Enables facilities to download clinician notes, patient history, and wound care improvement data. Also links to certification programs and Center of Excellence applications.
2016 investment announcement. Trivest Growth Investment Fund invested in Vohra. At that time: ~200 physicians, 2500+ facilities, 25 states, 4M+ patient encounters.
Company profile. ~382 employees, $50-100M revenue, 300+ physicians, 3000 SNFs across 28 states, headquartered in Miramar FL.
Physician recruitment page. Mentions proprietary EMR with administrative support, no after-hours documentation, average physician compensation $300K.
Interview with founder Dr. Ameet Vohra in Skilled Nursing News (found in search results but not fully fetched).
